source_notes: Delfin Midstream announced FID for Delfin FLNG 1 on 2026-06-03 ($5B; EPC Samsung Heavy + Black & Veatch; equity led by GIP/BlackRock, with MOL, Vitol, Diameter). GEM had FIDStatus=Pre-FID, FIDYear=2026; the FID is now actual. FIDYear=2026 already correct; only FIDStatus changes. Applies to T1 (FLNG 1) only — T2/T3 remain Pre-FID. Corroborated by two independent non-GEM sources (Delfin/GlobeNewswire release + Argus); both contain the FID announcement.
scope_note: Unit-level: FID is for the first vessel (T1) only; do NOT propagate FID to T2/T3.

source_notes: Delfin FLNG 1 nameplate export capacity = 4.4 mtpa per the 2026-06-03 FID release (total project authorization up to 13.2 mtpa across vessels). GEM Capacity/CapacityinMtpa for T1 were blank. Baseload/nameplate per vessel. CapacityUnits should be set to mtpa. The 4.4 value verified on two independent non-GEM pages (GlobeNewswire release + gCaptain).
scope_note: Per-vessel (T1). 4.4 mtpa is the FLNG 1 nameplate, not the 13.2 mtpa multi-vessel total.

source_notes: FID release states FLNG 1 'scheduled to begin LNG production in 2030'. GEM T1 LatestPlannedStartYear=2031. Yellow: 'production in 2030' is a target, not a confirmed commissioning date — value retained but flagged as a guidance target. The 2030 production target appears on two independent non-GEM pages (GlobeNewswire release + gCaptain).

GEM Location value was blank (only Location [ref] populated). Gulfstream LNG terminal sits in Plaquemines Parish, Louisiana (FERC Docket CP25-519, Belle Chasse / west bank Mississippi River). The prior FERC project page (ferc.gov) returned HTTP 403 to the verifier and was dropped; replaced with the DOE semi-annual report PDF (primary regulatory filing), LNG Prime, and Hart Energy — three independent non-GEM sources, each verified to contain 'Plaquemines'. Fills the blank Location value.

Blank-ref fill. DOE EIS-0491 (Lake Charles Liquefaction Project) confirms the terminal site is in Calcasieu Parish, Louisiana, on the existing LNG terminal site (GEM Location value='Lake Charles'). Corroborated independently by Oil & Gas Journal; both pages verified to contain 'Calcasieu'. No orphan ref — pairs existing Location value.
scope_note: Pairs existing Location value; do not change the value.
